name: Rot Hide Ichor
summary: Rot Hide Ichor is a foul bodily fluid harvested from the undead Rot Hide gnolls infesting Fenris Isle in Lordamere Lake. Apothecary Renferrel collects samples of the substance at the Sepulcher to uncover the origin of the gnolls' corruption and devise a strategy against them.

sections.title: A Plague in the Blood
sections.body: The Rot Hide gnolls of Fenris Isle are not ordinary wild beasts; they are visibly decomposed and twisted by unnatural blight. Rather than normal blood, their veins pump a noxious ichor that sustains their animated flesh. The Royal Apothecary Society suspects that this fluid holds the secret to how the pack was corrupted and who commands them from within the ruined keep of Fenris Isle.

sections.title: Apothecary Research
sections.body: Apothecary Renferrel gathers vials of this ichor to analyze its properties at the Sepulcher. By isolating the chemical and magical components fueling the gnolls, the Forsaken hope to pinpoint vulnerabilities before committing troops to a full-scale assault across Lordamere Lake.

faq.q: Where does Rot Hide Ichor come from?
aliases: where to get rot hide ichor
how to find rot hide ichor
faq.answer: It is gathered from the bodies of the Rot Hide gnolls dwelling across Fenris Isle, located in Lordamere Lake east of Silverpine Forest's mainland.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Renferrel want this ichor?
faq.answer: Renferrel seeks to dissect the strange fluid to discover what corrupted the gnolls and identify any physical or alchemical weaknesses the Forsaken can exploit before attacking the island.

faq.q: Are the Rot Hide gnolls Scourge?
faq.answer: They are undead gnolls warped by plague, but the Forsaken are actively investigating exactly who or what created them and commands their presence on Fenris Isle.

faq.q: Do all gnolls have this ichor?
faq.answer: No. The fluid is unique to the Rot Hide pack, whose flesh and blood have been corrupted by foul necromantic blights.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, studying the ichor is vital military intelligence to secure Silverpine's eastern flank and advance the Royal Apothecary Society's mastery over plague science.
